name: project girlboss
author: koko43
description:
Enter the solo portal at 34% as the ufo without holding the dash orb or hitting the cube portal and then fall to the floor. Move above the floor at 39% to avoid the invisible spider portal and then start spamming at the ceiling at 40%. Avoid the invisible block at the ceiling at 45% and then continue spamming until 48%, where you'll then fall to the floor. Hold the dash orb at 50% to re-enter the level.

hold through the slope as the wave at 57% and then fall to the floor after the cube portal. Fall between the diagonal wall of invisible spikes at 60%. Stay at the floor until 86%, where you'll then need to enter the swing portal and then click the black orb and hold until the level ends.
